title: FrontierMat: Benchmarking Language Models at the Frontier of Materials R&D
abstract: arXiv:2610.41162v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To accelerate materials discovery, language models must be able to address problems at the research frontier. Yet textbook- and examination-derived benchmarks primarily assess established knowledge, leaving performance on frontier research problems largely untested. We introduce FrontierMat, a benchmark of 330 problems drawn from frontier academic and industrial research in fields including aerospace, semiconductors, embodied intelligence and nuclear fusion. Every problem is validated by leading experimentalists and industry experts in its field. Each problem presents a real study and asks the model to infer a withheld outcome or draw a conclusion from selected experimental evidence. Problems are annotated by functional domain, material system and the scale of the governing mechanism; 130 require cross-scale reasoning. translated_title: FrontierMat：在材料研发前沿对语言模型进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 为了加速材料发现，语言模型必须能够解决处于研究前沿的问题。然而，源自教科书和考试的基准主要评估既有知识，导致模型在前沿研究问题上的表现基本未被检验。我们提出了FrontierMat，一个包含330道题目的基准，这些题目取自航空航天、半导体、具身智能和核聚变等领域的前沿学术与工业研究。每个问题均由该领域顶尖的实验科学家和行业专家进行验证。每个问题呈现一项真实研究，并要求模型推断被隐藏的结果，或从选定的实验证据中得出结论。问题按功能领域、材料体系和支配机制的尺度进行标注；其中130个问题需要跨尺度推理。最强的通用模型得分仅为53.7%，而在匹配的问题上，跨尺度问题的得分要低8.7个百分点。
tldr: FrontierMat是一个由330道经领域专家验证、取自航空航天、半导体、具身智能和核聚变等前沿学术与工业研究真实案例的材料研发基准，最强通用模型仅得53.7%的分数且在需要跨尺度推理的问题上表现更差，揭示了当前语言模型在应对材料研究前沿问题上的重大不足。
en_tdlr: FrontierMat is a benchmark of 330 expert-validated problems drawn from real frontier academic and industrial materials research (including aerospace, semiconductors, embodied intelligence, and nuclear fusion), on which the strongest general-purpose model scores only 53.7% — with even lower performance on cross-scale reasoning problems — revealing major gaps in language models' ability to tackle frontier materials R&D challenges.
